content.short: Most BNB Chain memecoins now launch on four.meme, trading on a bonding curve before graduating to PancakeSwap.
content.description: four.meme brings the bonding-curve launch model to BNB Chain. Anyone can create a token without writing code, buyers trade it on the curve, and once it reaches a set market cap the liquidity moves permanently to PancakeSwap. The platform has become the main home of BNB Chain memecoin activity. OpenFour extends it into an open launch layer that other builders can plug into. Creators pay a small fee to deploy, and the platform earns a trading fee on bonding-curve trades until a token graduates. It claims to have been the first fair-launch site for memecoins on BNB Chain.
